Marico's flagship projects and products under the Saffola brand include a dedicated health platform, Saffolalife.com, launched in 2005 to promote preventive healthcare. The platform has incorporated generative AI, notably with the "Heart to Heart Talk" campaign in 2025. The Saffola family of sub-brands includes Saffola FITTIFY Gourmet, Saffola ImmuniVeda, Saffola Arogyam, and Saffola Mealmaker, alongside core oils, and by FY23, expanded into oats, honey, noodles, peanut butter, mayonnaise, and ready-to-eat healthy snacking under the Saffola Munchie line. Saffola Life, a segment of Saffola, manufactures brands like oil, oats, muesli, and salt.

Marico institutionalised this shift beyond conventional product advertising through a dedicated, brand-owned health platform. In 2005, Saffola launched Saffolalife.com, a service focused on the health and nutrition aspects of preventive healthcare. Marico’s own press communications consistently describe this initiative in specific terms: Saffolalife is characterised as “a not-for-profit initiative by Marico Limited,” built on the company’s stated commitment to creating a “Heart Healthy India. [...] commitment to a Heart Healthy India. Most recently, the platform has incorporated generative AI into its execution. In 2025, Marico launched “Heart to Heart Talk,” described as an AI-based World Heart Day campaign, intended to create what the company called “a moment of truth for consumers” rooted in self-reflection about daily habits. The campaign tied directly back to product substantiation, featuring Saffola Total formulated with Oryzanol, positioned as helping reduce cholesterol as the oil [...] that an estimated 100 million Indians suffer from hypertension. By FY2019-20, the Saffola family of sub-brands disclosed in Marico’s own stock-exchange filings included Saffola FITTIFY Gourmet, Saffola ImmuniVeda, Saffola Arogyam and Saffola Mealmaker, alongside core oils. By FY23, this had extended further into oats, honey, noodles, peanut butter, mayonnaise and ready-to-eat healthy snacking under the Saffola Munchie line.

Saffola is a brand of Marico India, which manufactures brands like - Parachute, Livon, Nihar, Set Wet. The brands under the Saffolalife segment are : Oil, Oats, Muesli and Salt. Saffola has huge retail network, which makes it easily available across all the cities in the country.

Marico, a prominent consumer goods company known for brands like Parachute and Saffola, is strategically diversifying its portfolio by acquiring 4700BC, founded in 2012. This move allows Marico to tap into the rapidly expanding Indian snack market and cater to evolving consumer preferences for convenient, digitally-delivered food options. The acquisition aligns with Marico's existing efforts to expand its food portfolio, complementing its Saffola Gourmet range and potentially reaching a [...] online retail and specialized snack categories. This acquisition also allows Marico to leverage 4700BC's digital-first approach to marketing and distribution, enhancing its e-commerce capabilities and market reach.

Marico targets segments like value-added hair oil, oats, personal care, and hair gel and serum in youth. The company focuses on increasing market share in these areas, with a particular emphasis on capturing a significant share in the flavoured oats market. Marico's Saffola brand has seen growth in its premium edible oils franchise, with revenue and volume growth reported. The international business also showed strong momentum, particularly in Bangladesh and the MENA regions.

“Marico has bucked the trend in Q2 with 8% volume growth (6.5% in 1Q) in a challenging environment,” Prabhudas Lilladher analyst Amnish Aggarwal wrote in an investor note.

According to the analyst, the company intends to expand in areas of future growth, including oats. “Marico is focusing on increasing market share in future segments like value-added hair oil, oats, personal care and hair gel and serum in youth.”

Click here to view the Q2 update from Marico. [...] “Focus on value added offerings in the oats segment has enabled the company to capture 62% share in the flavoured oats market,” Marico noted. “The franchise is expected to reach a top line of circa INR700m-750m (US$12-13m) in this fiscal and is poised to cross INR100m (US$17m) landmark next year.” [...] Marico’s Indian premium edible oils franchise, which also trades under the Saffola brand, grew by 9.5% in volume terms during the second quarter. Value sales were also up as the group passed higher input costs along, hiking prices by an average of 3%.

On a group-wide basis, Marico reported revenues of INR14.3bn, up 28% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 16% to INR1.95bn. Net profit totalled INR1.18bn, up 12%.

In its key segments, Parachute revenue grew 59% year-over-year despite a 3% volume decline, while Saffola Oil saw 19% revenue growth with flat volume. Value-added Hair Oils revenue increased by 16%, led by double-digit volume growth in premium offerings.

The international business maintained strong momentum with 19% revenue growth, driven by strong performance in Bangladesh and MENA regions, while Vietnam showed gradual recovery.

Marico's key differentiators compared to other D2C companies lie in its unique approach to brand building and acquisition. Unlike traditional FMCG companies that typically acquire brands outright and integrate them fully, Marico follows a minority-to-majority approach. They invest early, let founders continue to run the business, and gradually increase ownership over time. This strategy combines traditional FMCG strengths like scale, efficiency, and distribution with startup traits like speed, experimentation, and sharp consumer insight. Marico is also strategically diversifying its portfolio by acquiring companies like 4700BC, which allows it to tap into the rapidly expanding Indian snack market and cater to evolving consumer preferences for convenient, digitally-delivered food options.
